parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing restriction is documented: no criminalisation of gender expression, no facility or bathroom ban, no border document friction, no police targeting, and no evidence of organised hostility. Institutional climate is strongly trans-respecting (self-declaration since 2022, supreme court backing a trans student's name, national action plan on anti-LGBTIQ hate crime adopted 2026). Deductions: Article 261bis covers sexual orientation, not gender identity, so hate-crime/hate-speech recourse for anti-trans acts is a documented gap; recording is poor and police do not log bias motivation, so protection is paper-thin in practice. Reported LGBTIQ hate crime rising fivefold is raw helpline counts, no denominator, not trans-specific — a direction-of-travel signal, not a magnitude. Detention placement is unlegislated nationally (open question, light weight). Absence of visitor-specific enforcement evidence keeps it just below the strongest tier.
